title: 2022 Panini Score Kyren Williams NFL Protential RC #P-KYW Los Angeles Rams
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2022 Panini Score trading card featuring Kyren Williams of the Los Angeles Rams. This card is a Protential Rookie insert from the 2022 set and has the card number #P-KYW. It is a sports trading card that is part of the National Football League (NFL) collection. The card is not autographed and showcases Kyren Williams as a rookie player for the Rams.
